note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row's annotation moved from {not-applicable} to {gap}. RFC 4035 Section 4.3 reads 'A security-aware resolver MUST be able to determine whether it should expect a particular RRset to be signed.' Ze's stub fills the security-aware resolver role (the summary holds it to the Section 4.1 rows: DO bit, 1220-octet size, advertised payload size), and local validation is post-release work, not declined (commit 5ff4834b67, plan/post-release/features/spec-dns-resolver-dnssec-validation.md), so the absent behaviour is a gap and the earlier not-applicable verdict no longer stands. internal/component/resolve/dns/resolver.go::dnssecDecision inspects only the upstream rcode (SERVFAIL) under the configured mode, with no trust anchor, DS chain, signature check or NSEC proof, and internal/plugins/dnsresolver/forward.go::upstreamQuery sends every upstream query with the DO bit clear, so no Ze code classifies an RRset as secure, insecure, bogus or indeterminate.
